papers.title_en: The IBVP for the Navier-Stokes equations in the half-space in a class of weighted Lebesgue spaces
papers.authors: Angelica Pia Di Feola, Vittorio Pane
papers.evidence: 加权Lebesgue空间中Navier-Stokes初边值问题的存在性与正则性
papers.tldr: 本文研究半空间上Navier-Stokes方程的初边值问题，初始数据位于加权Lebesgue空间，权重为到有限点距离幂的乘积。利用Stokes系统的加权空间框架，将Maremonti和Pane关于Cauchy问题的结果推广到边界情形。证明局部光滑解的存在唯一性，获得q>n的L^q估计及速度场的空间渐近行为。该工作完善了加权空间理论。
papers.abstract_en: We study the initial-boundary value problem for the Navier-Stokes equations in the half-space with initial data belonging to a suitable weighted Lebesgue space. More precisely, we consider a weighted Lebesgue space associated with a weight function defined as a product of powers of the distances from finitely many fixed points. This framework was introduced in a previous work by A. P. Di Feola and V. Pane (J. Math. Anal. Appl. 558 (2026), 130390) for the study of the initial-boundary value problem for the Stokes system. The present paper completes that analysis and, at the same time, generalizes to the initial-boundary value problem the results obtained by Maremonti and Pane (J. Math. Fluid Mech. 27 (2025), Art. 2) for the Navier-Stokes Cauchy problem. We prove the existence (local) and uniqueness of a smooth solution and derive $L^q$-estimates, with $q>n$, together with the spatial asymptotic behavior of the velocity field.

papers.title_en: Optimal Rigidity and Classification Results for the $k$-Hessian Equation of Lane--Emden Type
papers.authors: Wei Dai, Jingze Fu, Changfeng Gui, Guolin Qin
papers.evidence: k-Hessian Lane-Emden 方程的最优 Liouville 定理与刚性分类属于几何 PDE 研究。
papers.tldr: 针对k- Hessian Lane-Emden方程，本文解决了p在(p_-, p_*)区间内正解不存在性的开问题，建立了最优Liouville定理，并证明p_*是临界阈值。在临界情形p=p_*下，给出了解的完整分类，识别出Aubin-Talenti型泡解。该结果推广了经典Gidas-Spruck、Gidas-Ni-Nirenberg和Caffarelli-Gidas-Spruck理论到完全非线性情形。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we establish optimal Liouville theorems and classification results for the \(k\)-Hessian Lane--Emden equation \[   σ_k(-D^2u)=u^p\quad\text{in }\R^n,\qquad   -D^2u\in\overline{Γ_k},\qquad u\geq 0, \] where \(2\leq k<\frac{n}{2}\) and $p>0$. Let $p_- = \frac{nk}{n-2k}$ and the critical Hessian--Sobolev exponent $p_* = \frac{(n+2)k}{n-2k}$. Phuc and Verbitsky proved nonexistence of positive solutions for \(k<p\leq p_-\), while Ou subsequently covered the cases \(p\in(0,k]\). We completely closed this gap and proved the optimal Liouville theorem for any \(p_-<p<p_*\): any nonnegative \(C^2\) entire solution must be identically zero. We also prove the optimal Liouville theorem for nonnegative locally bounded Hessian-measure weak solutions. This identifies the critical exponent \(p_*\) as the sharp Liouville threshold, since radial positive solutions exist for \(p\geq p_*\).   For the critical case \(p=p_*\), we proved that nontrivial nonnegative \(C^2\) entire solution must be the Aubin-Talenti type bubble without any assumptions for \(2k<n\leq 4k\), under boundedness assumption for $n=4k+1$ and $4k+2$, and under some appropriate integral growth conditions or pointwise asymptotic behavior assumptions for any \(n>4k\) and the limiting case $n=2k$. In particular, we provide a fully nonlinear counterparts of the classical Liouville and classification theorems of Gidas--Spruck, Gidas--Ni--Nirenberg, and Caffarelli--Gidas--Spruck.

papers.title_en: Liouville-type theorems for coupled-drift Monge-Ampère equations
papers.evidence: 研究Monge-Ampere方程的Liouville定理与可解性，属于核心几何偏微分方程。
papers.tldr: 研究带耦合漂移的蒙日-安培方程整体解与周期校正子。利用任意维数下新建立的标量最大值原理，证明关键退化情形无整体解；结合势井分析，给出无漂移位势时的完整可解性分类：零漂移零斜率时解必为二次，内积非正时无解，其余情形存在非二次解。对周期位势，证明漂移胞问题存在唯一解，并建立渐近二次解与二次-周期校正子的对应关系，且需满足线性矩条件。该工作将经典刚性结论推广至漂移耦合情形，为随机均匀化提供了理论基础。
papers.abstract_en:
We study entire solutions and periodic correctors for the coupled-drift Monge-Ampère equation \[   \det D^2u   =   \exp\{-a\cdot Du+b\cdot x+V(x)-c_0\},   \quad   D^2u>0. \] For \(V\equiv0\), we obtain a sharp classification of the whole-space solvability regimes: all entire smooth strictly convex solutions are quadratic when \(a=b=0\); no such solution exists when \(a
eq0\) and \(a\cdot b\le0\); and non-quadratic entire solutions exist when \(a=0\) and \(b
eq0\), or when \(a\cdot b>0\). The main new ingredient is a scalar maximum-principle argument valid in every dimension \(n\ge2\), which proves that the null case \(a
eq0\), \(a\cdot b=0\) admits no entire smooth strictly convex solution.   For periodic \(V\), we establish the existence and uniqueness for the drifted cell problem \[   \det(A+D^2ψ)   =   \exp\{-a\cdot Dψ+V-c_A\},   \quad   A+D^2ψ>0   \quad	ext{on }\mathbb T^n. \] We also prove that any asymptotically quadratic entire solution must satisfy \(b=Aa\). If its remainder is bounded, then the solution is the corresponding quadratic-periodic corrector up to an additive constant.

papers.title_en: A Helmholtz-Leray projection method with variational multiscale stabilization for the Navier-Stokes equations
papers.authors: Biswajit Khara, Suresh Murugaiyan, Makrand Khanwale, Baskar Ganapathysubramanian
papers.evidence: 针对Navier-Stokes方程的数值方法，与需求中的NS部分相关。
papers.tldr: 不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程的Galerkin有限元面临速度-压力耦合与对流主导不稳定性，单块格式产生耦合非线性鞍点系统。本文提出残差型VMS稳定化的增量Helmholtz-Leray投影法，仅对预测速度作多尺度分解，将问题拆为非线性速度预测、压力Poisson方程和速度投影三个子问题。细尺度一致贡献引入SUPG/PSPG型稳定项，误差分解分离BDF2时间离散、投影分裂与空间VMS误差，得到二阶时间精度。方腔流、圆柱绕流及Taylor-Green涡等算例与参考数据吻合；相比单块VMS，阻力过预测和模型耗散降低，平均每步时间减少1.3-2.7倍。
papers.abstract_en: The Galerkin finite element formulation of the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations presents two principal challenges: maintaining stable velocity-pressure coupling and controlling instability in advection-dominated regimes. Moreover, the monolithic formulation produces a coupled nonlinear saddle-point problem. In this work, we present a residual-based variational multiscale (VMS) stabilization of an incremental Helmholtz-Leray projection method that replaces this coupled saddle-point problem with a nonlinear velocity predictor, a pressure Poisson equation, and a velocity projection. The multiscale decomposition is applied only to the predicted velocity; neither the pressure nor the corrected, weakly divergence-free velocity is decomposed into coarse and fine scales. The modeled velocity fine scale contributes consistently to all three subproblems, introducing SUPG-like stabilization in the momentum predictor and a PSPG-like residual contribution in the pressure Poisson equation. We provide a formal error decomposition that separates the BDF2 time-discretization, projection-splitting, and spatial-VMS errors and, under stated stability and spatial-approximation assumptions, yields a combined velocity error estimate with second-order temporal accuracy. Numerical results for manufactured solutions, lid-driven cavity flow, flow past a cylinder, and the Taylor-Green vortex agree closely with established reference data. Comparisons with monolithic VMS indicate that omitting the pressure fine scale reduces drag overprediction and excess modeled dissipation, at the cost of increased divergence error. In the Taylor-Green tests, the projection formulation also reduces the average solution time per step by factors ranging from approximately $1.3\times$ to $2.7\times$ under identical solver settings.

papers.title_en: Recovery of time-dependent coefficients for the convection-diffusion equation on conformally transversally anisotropic manifolds from partial data
papers.evidence: 共形横各向异性流形上PDE的反问题，属于几何偏微分方程研究
papers.tldr: 针对维数至少三的共形横向各向异性紧致黎曼流形，研究对流扩散方程中时间依赖对流项与密度系数的逆问题，目标是由部分边界输入输出数据恢复这两个系数。方法上利用衰减测地线X射线变换在横向流形上对一形式和函数的单射性，建立部分数据至系数的唯一性映射。主要结果证明在自然规范下，部分输入输出算子确实唯一确定系数，并允许边界数据缺失。这一工作将时间依赖系数的反演推广到更广泛的共形乘积几何，同时减弱了对完整边界测量的依赖。
papers.abstract_en: We study an inverse problem of recovering a time-dependent convection term and density coefficient of the convection-diffusion equation from partial data on a certain type of compact Riemannian manifold of dimension at least three. We prove that the knowledge of a partial input-output operator determines both coefficients uniquely up to a natural gauge. Our geometric setting is conformally transversally anisotropic manifolds, that is, compact Riemannian manifolds with boundary that are conformally embedded into a product of the Euclidean line and a transversal manifold. Additionally, we assume that the attenuated geodesic ray transforms of one-forms and functions are both injective on the transversal manifold.
